thread:
taylor_cs: Heads-up: Starlane dedicated bring-up scheduled in 45m. Quota = 250k tokens/min, burst 375k for 10m. Need an owner for the load test, autoscale confirmation, and canary route check.

arjun_ops: I got the smoke & soak. I'll run a 30m job (5m ramp, 20m steady, 5m rampdown). Will target 210 rps to hit steady ~240k tpm. Command: 
```
loadgen --acct Starlane --rps 210 --dur 30m --concurrency 48 --prompts loadsets/starlane-prime.json
```

maya_eng: Model pinned is rdx-13b-int8 in this pool. Note: KV-cache warm observed ~45-70s on long-history prompts in staging. Recommend a 400-token prefix prime and enabling prefix caching.

luis_platform: Autoscale config we'll apply: 
```
policy: adaptive
min_replicas: 1
target_rps_per_replica: 40
scale_up_cooldown: 20s
scale_down_cooldown: 90s
max_replicas: 10
fallback: rdx-3b-cost
```

qa_lead: Quick staging dry run just now: intermittent 503s during short burst at 7 replicas. Logs show a single CUDA allocation failure on gpu-node-05 then pod restart. Snippet: 
```
W runtime: GPU allocator OOM trying to allocate 900MiB
E inference: kv-cache restore failed for session abc123
```

arjun_ops: Thanks. I'll set node GPU margin to 0.88 and enable anti-affinity so we don't pack pods on the same host. Running the soak in ~10m and will post metrics.

deploy-bot: config apply: autoscale/adaptive pushed to pool starlane-dedicated by luis_platform at 2025-02-01T14:12:03Z :white_check_mark:

maya_eng: Also enabling automatic fallback to rdx-3b-cost if errors >1.5% or sustained p95 > 650ms for 2m.

qa_lead: 15m update: ramp complete, holding. error_rate=0.45%, p95=410ms, scaled from 2->6 replicas. One pod restart observed at 00:09 (OOM), but recovered. Artifacts uploaded to /artifacts/starlane/soak-1745551111.

arjun_ops: Observed peak tokens/min ~338k during a short spike (~6s). No persistent latency spikes. Continuing hold.

taylor_cs: Good signal. Post-soak checklist: QA to run semantic checks on saved traces, CS to update enablement guide with warmup prefix and fallback behavior, and renewals notified if we see repeated regressions. I'll prep a short runbook note.

luis_platform: Runbook note posted, channel #starlane-ready created, will run quick retro tomorrow.

qa_lead: Final: soak complete. final_error=0.66%, final_p95=398ms, 49/50 quality checks pass, one regression logged (investigating).

taylor_cs: Filing renewal risk flag: regression contained, timeline for remediation requested. Thanks team, closing loop once QA remediation is captured.
